description: This file contains CSS styles for a theme management system in a frontend application. It defines themes and various styles for UI components, including colors and animations.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main container for the application, styled to center content and apply theme colors.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the application, configured for layout and background styles.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styled link within the application that inherits theme color properties.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling between light and dark themes, with hover and active state effects.
